completed_tasks.name: crossencoder-ms-marco-MiniLM-L12-v2
completed_tasks.description: test deeper 12-layer cross-encoder on all items
completed_tasks.reasoning: While Qwen2.5-7B achieved the highest Recall@10 (0.7739) and NDCG@5 (0.6993), its coarse discrete grading and failure on empty queries held back MRR compared to ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2 (0.7989). First, we evaluate the deeper 12-layer cross-encoder checkpoint (ms-marco-MiniLM-L12-v2) to test if increased model capacity improves dense cross-attention ranking. Second, we implement a hybrid reranker combining LLM candidate recall with cross-encoder scoring and fallback, addressing the coarse ranking and empty-result failure modes documented in APPROACHES.md.

completed_tasks.details: Implement a hybrid search engine in research/search/hybrid_search.py and register --engine hybrid in research/search/engines.py. The hybrid engine takes LLM candidate rankings (--rankings) and rescores them with a CrossEncoder (--model), using the cross-encoder score (optionally with an LLM grade boost) to produce fine-grained ordering, and falls back to full cross-encoder search when the LLM returns no matches. Verify with evaluate.py --engine hybrid --rankings research/agent/runs/qwen2.5-7b-instruct.jsonl --model cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2.
